description: This file contains methods for managing files within the focalboard application, including saving, retrieving, copying, moving, and handling file info, as well as copying files associated with board cards.

classes.name: App
classes.description: Main application struct providing file management methods.

methods.name: SaveFile
methods.description: Saves a file from an io.Reader to storage, generating a new filename or using a template.

methods.name: GetFileInfo
methods.description: Retrieves file information based on filename.

methods.name: GetFile
methods.description: Retrieves file info and a reader for the specified file.

methods.name: GetFilePath
methods.description: Determines the file path for a given filename, teamID, and rootID.

methods.name: GetFileReader
methods.description: Provides a reader for the specified file, moving it from an old location if necessary.

methods.name: MoveFile
methods.description: Moves a file from one path to another.

methods.name: CopyAndUpdateCardFiles
methods.description: Copies files associated with a board's blocks and updates database references.

methods.name: CopyCardFiles
methods.description: Copies files attached to cards, adjusting paths for templates.
